title: How to Cancel YouTube TV & Get a Refund
metaDescription: Cancel YouTube TV on computer, mobile, or third-party billing. Learn step-by-step subscription cancellation, how to pause, and refund policies.
intro: YouTube TV has a simple subscription model with no cancellation fees, but billing automatically rolls over unless canceled. You can cancel your subscription or free trial at any time.

steps.title: Open YouTube TV settings
steps.text: Go to tv.youtube.com on your computer or mobile web browser. Click on your profile photo in the top right and select "Settings". Note: iOS users cannot cancel subscriptions from the YouTube TV App.

steps.title: Go to Membership section
steps.text: In the Settings menu, click on "Membership". You will see your active membership, Base Plan, and any active Add-ons.

steps.title: Click Pause or Cancel Membership
steps.text: Next to your Base Plan, click "Manage". Then click "Pause or cancel membership" or "Cancel membership".
steps.tip: YouTube TV allows you to pause your membership for up to 6 months if you just want a temporary break.

steps.title: Choose Cancellation and Confirm
steps.text: Click "Cancel" to proceed. Select your reason for leaving, then click "Continue canceling". Finally, click "Yes, cancel" to complete the process.
steps.tip: If you are on a paid plan, your service remains active until the end of your billing cycle. If on a free trial, your service ends immediately.

warnings: Free trial cancellations take effect IMMEDIATELY. You will lose access to all channels, DVR recordings, and add-ons right away.
Paid plans remain active until your next billing date — no partial or prorated refunds are standard.
If you billed through Apple/iTunes, you must cancel through iOS Settings -> Apple ID Subscriptions.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund for YouTube TV?
faqs.a: YouTube TV does not offer refunds for partial billing periods. However, if you forgot to cancel a trial or had an accidental charge, you can request a refund through the Google Play Refund Support page.

faqs.q: What happens to my recorded DVR shows when I cancel?
faqs.a: Your recorded shows in your Library are saved for 21 days. If you re-subscribe within 21 days, your recordings will be restored. After that, they are permanently deleted.

refund.details: Refunds are generally not provided. However, Google provides an automatic refund tool for certain situations (e.g., accidental renewals or unrecognized charges) at support.google.com.

retentionTactics: Offering to pause subscription instead of complete cancellation.
Highlighting that your unlimited DVR library will be deleted after 21 days.
